title: Tighten Claude Agent SDK missing-package detection
description:
Problem
PR #254 made the Claude Agent SDK lazy-loaded so installer editions that omit Claude can still import @eshyra/core. That was the right direction, but the missing-SDK detection is too broad.

Current suspected issue
The helper that detects a missing Claude Agent SDK appears to treat any ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND / MODULE_NOT_FOUND as "Claude SDK is not installed." That is only correct when the missing package is actually @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk.

Why this matters
If @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk is installed but one of its own transitive/runtime dependencies is missing or broken, Eshyra may incorrectly show the friendly installer-edition error:

  install the "claude" or "full" edition

instead of surfacing the real dependency/runtime failure. That would make a real broken install harder to diagnose.

Relevant PR
- PR #254: lazy Claude Agent SDK loading / installer edition smoke validation

Likely files
- packages/core/src/model/agentSdkLoader.ts
- packages/core/test/model/agentSdkLoader.test.ts or nearby tests

Requested fix
Tighten the missing-package detection so module-resolution errors are converted to the friendly edition error only when the missing module/package is actually @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk.

Do not classify arbitrary ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND / MODULE_NOT_FOUND errors as a missing Claude edition.

Acceptance criteria
- If @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk itself is absent, loading the Claude SDK still produces the existing friendly ModelClientError / installer-edition guidance.
- If dynamic import fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND or MODULE_NOT_FOUND for some other package, for example "some-sdk-internal-dep", the original error is rethrown or preserved rather than converted to the friendly edition error.
- An unrelated runtime error that merely mentions Claude or the SDK name is not misclassified as a missing package.
- Tests cover all of the above cases.
- Existing installer-edition validation still passes.
- Run the normal verification command before opening the PR, preferably:
    npm run verify:worktree
close_reason: Tightened Claude Agent SDK missing-package detection and added regression coverage for SDK-internal failures.
